description: Ranked best-fit tools for a goal, matched on verified capabilities (not categories), with why + caveat. Saved tags can reorder equally-matched tools by up to 2 points when the new matcher is on (platforms/preferences tags only); they never override a verified-capability filter, and with the flag off they have no effect. Pass the goal in plain words, or the already-extracted structured task object (task: action, input_type, output_type, required_capabilities / forbidden_capabilities capability ids, hard_constraints tokens, confidence, known_context) — the server validates the task object and rejects invalid tasks with an error; in the top-level required_capabilities / forbidden_capabilities / hard_constraints arrays, unknown ids/tokens are dropped or ignored instead. May answer need_clarification with exactly one question, or no_match when no catalog tool verifies the task. The capability matcher is canary-gated; while its flag is off, the previous matcher answers instead (same response shape, no decision field). On a new user's first call, also returns short onboarding questions (project types, platforms, budget, preferences, tools in use) for you to ask, then call set_preferences with tags only.

forbidden_capabilities.description: Capability ids the task must not need, e.g. ['text-to-video']. Unknown ids are ignored (they match nothing). Honoured by the new (canary) matcher only.

hard_constraints.description: Hard-constraint tokens, e.g. 'offline', 'windows-only', 'no-cloud-upload', 'budget-zero-no-card'. Unknown tokens are ignored. Honoured by the new (canary) matcher only.

required_capabilities.description: Capability ids the task must have, e.g. ['video-editing','auto-captions']. Unknown ids are dropped. Honoured by the new (canary) matcher only.

task.description: Structured task (optional). The server validates it and rejects invalid tasks with an error. Honoured by the new (canary) matcher only.
